newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Sampoerna denies founder sells stake.
newsitem.headline: Sampoerna denies founder sells stake.

text.p: Indonesia's largest cigarette firm PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna on Wednesday denied reports that founder and president director Putera Sampoerna no longer held a direct stake in the company.
Putera Sampoerna has 23,830,000 shares, or about a 5.3 percent direct stake, in PT Sampoerna, the company said in a statement.
"Shares of the Sampoerna family also remain the same at 55.34 percent or about 249,010,000 shares," it said.
Kompas newspaper reported on Wednesday that Putera Sampoerna no longer held a direct stake in PT Sampoerna.
The paper also said that some investment companies owned by Putera Sampoerna had reduced their stakes in PT Sampoerna.
